A SMALL RHYME BANK

Verse, one tap away.

On iPhone: open Verse in Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

Use the same Verse address each time. Ideas are saved separately in each browser or installed app. Export a backup before switching, then import it there.

Open online once and wait for “Ready for offline capture”, then you can reopen this same address to capture and save without internet. First-time setup and some dictation features need internet. Keep backups; offline access does not provide cloud sync.
